title: RetrievalInput
description: Everything the Retrieval component needs for one request. This is the Backend -> Retrieval contract (Section 14) — jointly owned by Person 1 and Person 2.

query_text_raw.description: The user's query exactly as typed, before any normalization.

query_text_segmented.description: The query after Vietnamese word segmentation (Section 8.2). This is what actually feeds the exact-string shortcut, lexical index, and embedding step — never the raw text.

filters.description: Explicit constraints extracted during interpretation, or carried over from ConversationState.

conversation_session_id.description: ID of the ConversationState this request belongs to, if any. Null for a stateless/first-turn request.

top_k.description: Maximum number of candidate fragments to return before bundling.
